english.title: Producer or representative fail to inform scheme operator of material change within 28 days

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: the Waste Electrical and electronic equipment regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[a producer]_
(B)_[an authorised representative of a producer]_

who was a member of a scheme approved under regulation 55 of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013, failed to inform the operator of the scheme, namely **(..SPECIFY OPERATOR..), in writing of a material change in the information provided to that operator in accordance with regulation 18 of those regulations within 28 days of the occurrence of the change
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 18(2)(b), 90(1)(a) and 91(1) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013.
